purpose: Counterfactual numeric check of global translation information removed by per-frame min/max normalization
confirmed_source_fact: Independent per-frame min/max removes frame translation and extent before both ST-GCN streams. It is upstream-compatible but may hide global descent.
hypothesis_not_confirmed: Using shared extrema over a causal window might preserve early whole-body descent. Pretrained input distribution changes and pose outliers may hurt accuracy.
